title: Phase 6: Set up environment configuration for production
acceptance_criteria: Production .env files created with secure values
Secrets management strategy (use .env.local, not in repo)
Database credentials configured for Neon PostgreSQL
API URLs and origins properly set
code_example:
```bash
# frontend/.env.production.example
# Copy to .env.production and fill in values

# API Configuration
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://ctms.yourdomain.com/api
API_URL=https://ctms.yourdomain.com/api

# Authentication
NEXTAUTH_URL=https://ctms.yourdomain.com
NEXTAUTH_SECRET=your-generated-secret-here

# App Router Configuration
NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

# Feature Flags
NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ANALYTICS=true
```

```bash
# backend/.env.production.example
# Copy to .env and fill in values

APP_NAME=CTMS
APP_ENV=production
APP_KEY=base64:your-generated-app-key
APP_DEBUG=false
APP_URL=https://ctms.yourdomain.com

LOG_CHANNEL=stack
LOG_LEVEL=error

DB_CONNECTION=pgsql
DB_HOST=your-neon-host.neon.tech
DB_PORT=5432
DB_DATABASE=ctms
DB_USERNAME=your-neon-username
DB_PASSWORD=your-neon-password
DB_SSLMODE=require

BROADCAST_DRIVER=log
CACHE_DRIVER=file
QUEUE_CONNECTION=database
SESSION_DRIVER=file
SESSION_LIFETIME=120

SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS=ctms.yourdomain.com
SESSION_DOMAIN=.yourdomain.com
```
